\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{shapes.geometric,automata}
\newsavebox{\roundbox}
\newdimen\ax
\newdimen\ay
\newcommand{\readanchor}[2]{%
  \pgfextractx{\ax}{\pgfpointanchor{N}{#2}}%
  \pgfextracty{\ay}{\pgfpointanchor{N}{#2}}%
  \typeout{ANCHOR #1 #2: \the\ax\space\the\ay}}
\newcommand{\probe}[4][]{%
  \sbox{\roundbox}{\begin{tikzpicture}[#1]
    \node[#3] (N) {#4};
    \pgftransformreset
    \readanchor{#2}{east}\readanchor{#2}{north}
    \readanchor{#2}{north east}\readanchor{#2}{45}
  \end{tikzpicture}}%
  \typeout{PAGE #2: \the\wd\roundbox\space\the\dimexpr\ht\roundbox+\dp\roundbox\relax}}
\begin{document}
\probe{circle}{circle,minimum size=30pt,draw,line width=4pt,outer xsep=8pt,outer ysep=2pt}{}
\probe{ellipse}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,draw,line width=4pt,outer xsep=8pt,outer ysep=2pt}{}
\probe{lastsep}{circle,minimum size=30pt,draw,outer xsep=8pt,outer sep=1pt}{}
\probe{state}{state,accepting,line width=2pt}{}
\probe{override}{state,accepting,line width=2pt,outer sep=3pt}{}
\probe{color}{circle,minimum size=30pt,draw=blue,fill=yellow,double=red,double distance=3pt,line width=2pt}{}
\probe{rotate}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,draw,line width=4pt,rotate=30}{Box}
\probe{invisible}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,rotate=30}{}
\probe{silent}{circle,minimum size=30pt,rotate=45}{}
\probe[scale=1.5,transform shape]{scaled}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,draw=blue,double=red,double distance=3pt,line width=2pt}{}
\probe{localscale}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,draw=blue,scale=1.5,line width=2pt}{}
\probe{negative}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,draw,outer sep=-2pt}{}
\probe{textcircle}{circle,draw,minimum size=8pt,inner sep=2pt}{Center}
\probe{textellipse}{ellipse,draw,inner sep=1pt,text height=12pt}{g}
\probe{depth}{circle,draw,inner xsep=2pt,inner ysep=3pt,text depth=5pt}{Ag}
\probe{reverse}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,rotate=-30}{}
\probe{quadrant}{ellipse,minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,rotate=135}{}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \foreach \s in {0.2cm,0.4cm,0.6cm,0.65cm,1cm,8cm,8mm}{
    \node[circle,minimum size=\s,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] (c) {};
    \pgfextractx{\ax}{\pgfpointanchor{c}{east}}
    \typeout{MINRADIUS \s: \number\ax sp}}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
